name: Mercedes 722.6 5-speed TCU (EGS52)
cpu: Infineon C167 family (SAK-C167; the open EGS52 emulator models a C167CS)
eeprom: separate serial EEPROM (the open EGS52_emu loads it as its own image); part number not confirmed by an open source

read_methods.notes: Bench connection: supply, ground and K-line on C1 (ecupinouts); CAN is on the C2 connector (ATSG). OBD programming capability is not documented in the cited sources. Board-level boot: the C167 bootstrap loader (access.boot).

notes: External (body-mounted) TCU for the Mercedes 722.6 5-speed automatic, also used by Chrysler. Per ATSG, 1996-1999 units read the range switch on C1-25..28 while 2000+ units use CAN. The open-source ultimate_nag52 project is a drop-in replacement TCU for EGS51/52/53 cars. No OpenTune checksum applies. Hardware (open-source projects): a C167-family CPU with 512 KiB of external flash and a separate serial EEPROM (rnd-ash/EGS52_emu maps a 512 KiB flash image, models a C167CS and loads a separate EEPROM image; Ultimate-NAG52: EGS52/53 on C166/ST10). The flash and EEPROM part numbers are not confirmed by an open source - read them from the chips.

pins.function: Diagnosis line to the data-link connector (K-line)

pins.note: Sources do not say whether this is switched; feed +12 V on the bench.
Solenoid feed - not needed to talk to the TCU on the bench.

bench.notes: +12 V to C1-29, ground C1-30, K-line C1-1. CAN-H/L are on C2 (pins labelled H and L) if your tool uses CAN.
bench.resistor_notes: For CAN on the bench a forum thread recommends terminating the bus (about 60 ohm across CAN-H/CAN-L).

safety_note: Bench safety: use a current-limited bench supply (12-13.8 V, start with a low current limit) and a fuse in the +12 V lead; connect ground first. Confirm every pin with a multimeter on YOUR unit before applying power - ground pins should show continuity to each other (and usually the housing), and hardware revisions can differ from the sources. A CAN bus needs about 60 ohm between CAN-H and CAN-L (two 120 ohm terminations): add a 120 ohm resistor if neither the unit nor your interface terminates. Swapped CAN-H/CAN-L just gives timeouts; +12 V on a signal pin can destroy the unit.

sources.title: ATSG 722.6 service manual: TCM connectors and terminal identification
ecupinouts.com: Siemens EGS52 / EGS53 bench pinout
rnd-ash/EGS52_emu (GPL-3.0): EGS52 emulator that simulates the C167CS CPU and maps the flash file as a 512 KiB (0x80000) image
rnd-ash/ultimate-nag52-fw-rs README (GPL-3.0): EGS52/53 are based on a C166/ST10 processor, EGS51 on an SEC51C810
Infineon C167CR Derivatives User's Manual V3.1: ch. 14 bootstrap loader, Table 19-2 reset configuration
Infineon C167CR data sheet: P-MQFP-144 pin 104 = P0L.4/AD4
rnd-ash/ultimate-nag52-fw lib/slave_ecus/README.md (GPL-3.0): stock EGS52 security access level for a service function; flash read on an external reader

obd.protocol: K-line diagnosis line to the data-link connector (C1-1); CAN on C2 on 2000+ units. The diagnostic protocol is not stated in the cited sources.
obd.notes: Whether a complete read or a write works over the diagnostic socket is not documented in a cited public source. OpenTune does not talk to this TCU's diagnostics yet.

bench.how: +12 V to C1-29, ground C1-30, K-line C1-1 (ATSG and ecupinouts agree); CAN-H/L on C2 pins H and L (ATSG only). The same diagnostic link and security access as in the car apply.

boot.mcu_mode: C167 bootstrap loader (BSL) on ASC0, entered with P0L.4 low at the end of a hardware reset: the host sends one zero byte, the BSL answers with an identification byte (C5h/D5h) and loads 32 bytes of loader code. OpenTune's bsl preset 'egs52' covers the 512 KiB external-flash window but not yet the board's bus setup.

points.name: P0L.4 / AD4 strap
points.location: pcb:P0L.4 net (not publicly located on the EGS52 board)
points.note: No public source gives the pad on this board. Trace P0L.4 from the CPU (pin 104 on the C167CR P-MQFP-144 per its data sheet; confirm for the fitted C167 variant) or from the flash data pin wired to it, and confirm by continuity.

boot.reset_timing: P0L.4 low at the end of the hardware reset (power-up), P0L.5, P0L.3 and P0L.2 high (Table 19-2); release the strap once the BSL has answered.
boot.notes: Board level: the TCU must be opened. The C167 bootstrap loader is the CPU's standard boot path (Infineon manual); no open source confirms the pad for this board. The Ultimate-NAG52 author read his unit's flash on an external reader (chip-off).

security.notes: The stock EGS52 has diagnostic security-access levels (the Ultimate-NAG52 notes name a 'Siemens level' access for a service function); what a complete read or a write over diagnostics needs is not publicly documented. OpenTune ships no OEM key.
